To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the wind speed of the wind turbine is the main factor affecting the wind power generation.
the actual power available from the wind and generated power using artificial wind generation is almost same.
the actual wind speed and the expected power generation from artificial wind is more compared to the available wind speed in moving vehicle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a small wind turbine for the generation of electricity from the kinetic energy of the wind, which can be used for lighting, charging mobile phone, etc.
the development of an efficient wind power generation system for a vehicle.
the estimation of wind power using two wheeler and artificial wind generation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the wind turbine can be used as a power source for two wheelers.
wind power can be generated using artificial wind generation.
wind energy is the clean and inexhaustible source.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the power generated from artificial wind is very less when compared to actual wind.
the wind speed and power generated by wind machine are estimated by using two wheeler as a vehicle and artificial wind generation system.
, we have successfully developed a small wind turbine which is capable of producing power from wind.
The main takeaway from our work is that
wind energy can be generated by artificial means.
wind energy is a viable source of energy for small scale power generation.
wind power can be generated using the two wheeler and it is a good source of power.
